root_cause.text: Off-by-one error in the second memcpy of `lowpan_iphc_mcast_ctx_addr_compress()`, where both the destination and source offsets are one byte too low, causing corruption of the RIID field and leaving `data[5]` unwritten, which leads to transmission of uninitialized kernel stack memory over the network.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The second memcpy in lowpan_iphc_mcast_ctx_addr_compress() uses &data[1] as destination and &ipaddr->s6_addr[11] as source, but both should be offset by one: &data[2] and &ipaddr->s6_addr[12] respectively." And the patch diff confirms the change from `memcpy(&data[1], &ipaddr->s6_addr[11], 4)` to `memcpy(&data[2], &ipaddr->s6_addr[12], 4)`, along with zero-initialization of the `data` array as a defensive measure.
